verdict.rationale: Internal comment threads and @mentions on emails are a fair capability for an email client, so the axis applies. The evidence covers labels, AI composing, thread Q&A, search and self-hosting, but nothing documents team comments, side-threads or @mentions on a message. The AI 'ask questions about specific email threads' feature is a different capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around
